answer: Reputation-Jetty Expiry Detector. Each identity accumulates a public transaction jetty whose width is the count of distinct settlement partners over a rolling window; genuine agents form a broad, slowly widening jetty, while sybils funnel through few partners and show a narrowing spiral toward the window's edge. Detector flags clusters whose partner overlap exceeds threshold, then prunes their accrued fee rebates retrospectively. Attacker pays one full registration deposit plus lost rebate yield per fake identity across the whole grove,
